title: Learn: Leer libros todos los días | AB Spanish #Shorts

subtitles.en: Reading helps me learn new words and ideas.
subtitles.zh: 閱讀能幫助我學習新單字和新想法。

subtitles.en: In the morning, I read a short story before school.
subtitles.zh: 早晨上學前，我會讀一篇短篇故事。

subtitles.en: At school, I visit the library and borrow books.
subtitles.zh: 在學校時，我會去圖書館借書。

subtitles.en: At home, I sit in a quiet place and read.
subtitles.zh: 回到家裡，我會坐在安靜的地方閱讀。

subtitles.en: Sometimes, I read with my family or friends.
subtitles.zh: 有時候，我會和家人或朋友一起閱讀。

subtitles.en: We talk about the story, and it is fun.
subtitles.zh: 我們會聊聊故事內容，這非常有趣。

subtitles.en: I also write new words in my notebook.
subtitles.zh: 我也會把新單字記在筆記本上。

subtitles.en: Reading makes me happy, and it helps me improve my English.
subtitles.zh: 閱讀讓我感到快樂，也幫助我提升英文能力。

subtitles.en: Every book is like a new adventure!
subtitles.zh: 每一本書都像是一場嶄新的冒險！
